coverage_limits: Attention layers 0 (SWA) and 3 (DSA) stand for every layer with the same attention block; Frontier prices the other 90 layers from them
Decode cells cover every lane state of the fixed 6144/1024 workload with at most three 16-token prompt tails in one decode step; four or more tails fall outside the measured range and Frontier raises
DSA decode contexts stop at 7160 because repeated DSA timing needs region-aligned contexts; Frontier extends the DSA context range by region_block_size - 1
MoE tokens cover the per-lane width and its DP2 and DP4 sums, because the token count Frontier passes to the MoE predictor under attention DP is not yet confirmed
MoE uses uniform load with standard_fused_topk; the native run used the position_cyclic routing image built on the same base image
The base image is the routing image's base, so attention and linear kernels match the native run; no native generation binding is applied
No kernel-gap, NIXL, sampler, host or communication timing is measured by this package
